BillingResponse.title: BillingResponse
BillingResponse.description: Calculated billing breakdown — all amounts serialised to 2 dp.

InspectionData.title: InspectionData
InspectionData.description: Inspection findings recorded during the job.

JobCompleteUpdate.title: JobCompleteUpdate
JobCompleteUpdate.description:
Trigger billing calculation and mark job as COMPLETED.

Billing is derived from the job's services + labour JSONB.
An optional notes field is added to the timeline entry.

JobCreate.title: JobCreate
JobCreate.description:
Create a job.

Two creation paths:
- Direct: customer_name, customer_mobile, registration_number, brand,
          vehicle_model, fuel_type, odometer_km are required.
- Booking: customer_id + vehicle_id supplied (existing FK records used).

JobDetailResponse.title: JobDetailResponse
JobDetailResponse.description: Job with nested customer, vehicle, and timeline.

JobUpdate.title: JobUpdate
JobUpdate.description:
Partial update for inspection, services, labour, photos, or description.

Only supplied fields are written; unset fields are left untouched.
JSONB fields are fully replaced (not merged) when provided.

SendOTPRequest.title: SendOTPRequest
SendOTPRequest.description:
Request a fresh OTP. Supply the plain 10-digit mobile number only.
The backend looks up the registered country code and builds the full
number before calling MSG91.

ServiceItem.title: ServiceItem
ServiceItem.description: One line-item in the services list.

SignInRequest.title: SignInRequest
SignInRequest.description:
Sign in with a plain 10-digit mobile number.
No country code required — resolved from the stored user record.

VerifyOTPRequest.title: VerifyOTPRequest
VerifyOTPRequest.description:
Verify an OTP. Supply the plain 10-digit mobile and the OTP code.
Country code is resolved from the stored user record.

AdminBearerAuth.description: Dedicated admin access token. Obtain it from the private sign-in/MFA flow.
